issue.title: Refresh 6 stale ACE PNG snapshot goldens
issue.description: just test-visual fails 6 of 393 cases on a clean master: test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_panel_clan_collapse.py::test_selected_panel_clan_collapse_precedes_status_group_png_snapshot, test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_panels.py::test_agents_sole_selected_panel_png_snapshot, test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_panels.py::test_agents_collapsed_panel_png_snapshot, test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots, test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_tribe_panel.py::test_tribe_panel_display_config_png_snapshot, and test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_tribe_panel.py::test_tribe_panel_four_level_png_snapshots. Proposed by sase-bv.2 and sase-bv.4, which reported 53 failures; the tribe-panel commits 574b7761f and 7e9527c7a have since fixed 47 of them, leaving this residue. Fix: confirm the remaining diffs are the intended tribe-header layout change and then accept them with --sase-update-visual-snapshots.
